clips.title: The story
paras: In Teldrassil, Denalan gives adventurers a heart still troubled by corruption. Though its outer foul moss is gone, lingering energies remain, and he seeks to cleanse them with rich soil.

Teldrassil's natural balance is troubled by a malady that warps its plants and beasts. After foul moss is stripped from a blighted growth, Denalan gives adventurers the Tainted Heart within. Darkness still clings to its tissue. Denalan hopes specially prepared, nutrient-rich earth can counter the taint and restore what was corrupted.
